name: fo-inheritance-duty
description: Calculate Faroese inheritance and succession duty for 2026 estates, legacies, death benefits, inheritance advances and retained-use gifts. Classifies the recipient's relationship, applies the whole-share rate table, aggregates receipts from the same deceased and distinguishes estate-wide exemptions from individual allowances. Covers net-benefit valuation, undivided estates, usufructs, cross-border assets and payment liability. Supplies the actual probate inventory fields, original-paper submission route, assessment, filing and payment clocks, late interest and penalties. Trigger on Faroe Islands inheritance tax, arvaavgjald, succession duty, inherited property, life insurance on death and an inheritance declaration. Estate income tax and the deceased's final income-tax assessment use the separate estate-tax Guide.
